bio.text: Laura Ellman, a Democrat, has represented Illinois's 21st Senate District since 2019, according to the General Assembly.
Her General Assembly biography lists her as an assessor at a national laboratory with more than 25 years of experience in manufacturing and engineering.
It says she holds a B.A. in mathematics from Grinnell College and an M.A. in applied statistics from the University of Iowa, and lives in Naperville with her husband and two adult children.
